meta.name: Jamila
meta.source: Live storefront e-majestic.com; product data from data/majestic_catalog.json.
meta.generated: web/tokens.css is generated from this file by `python -m scripts.build_web`. Edit here, not there.
replace_first: color.brand and color.deep: taken from a brand registry, not the theme's own CSS.
radius: read off screenshots of the product grid.
font: the brief's fallback choice; no font declaration was readable.
Avatar: a line mark stands in until the real artwork arrives. There is no Majestic logo in this system.

surface-tint.note: Warm accent wash: user bubbles, the disclaimer, chip hover.

ink.note: Body copy. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

ink-muted.note: Secondary lines. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

ink-subtle.note: Struck prices, timestamps, placeholders and the footer credit: the lightest text the system allows. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

brand.inferred: Brand registry; the theme's CSS could not be read.
brand.note: Fill only. 2.95:1 on white, so it never carries text or a meaning-bearing icon on its own. Lightens in the dark theme.

on-brand.note: Text and icons on a brand fill, in both themes. Never ink, never white: white fails on the lighter dark-theme brand.

brand-ink.note: The brand tone as text: links, the Details action, active filter labels. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

deep.inferred: Brand registry; the theme's CSS could not be read.

deep-ink.note: The deep tone as text: the saving line. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

success.note: Teal, not green, so it stays apart from danger off the red-green axis. Always beside a word or an icon. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

danger.note: Errors. Always beside a word or an icon. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

warning.note: Sits beside the word it qualifies. Legible on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and surface-tint.

border.note: Hairline separator. Decorative, so no contrast floor.

border-strong.note: A boundary that carries meaning: the composer outline, a secondary button, a chip edge. 3:1 on every ground.

focus-offset.note: The 2px halo between the element and the ring. On a brand fill the ring carries the contrast; on a deep fill the halo does. One of the two always clears 3:1.
